name: Loading bay
blurb: Roll-up doors, pallet jacks, one cam.
description: Diesel and wet cardboard hang in the air. Roll-up doors rattle on warped tracks under one red-winking cam.

name: Concrete stairwell
description: A cold concrete stairwell where every step doubles back as echo. Graffiti spirals the landings; old blood stains the third.

name: Server closet
blurb: Hot air, blinking LEDs, tight fit.
description: Dry electric heat and screaming fans pack the racks wall-to-wall. Barely room to turn — touch the wrong port and the floor will know.

name: Open office floor
description: After-hours cubicles and sleep-glowing monitors. Motion lights snap on in stages, advertising every step across thin cover and long sightlines.

name: Secure lab
description: Filtered air, glass partitions, and glove boxes under peeling biohazard stickers. Something inside still hums; the cleanup was never finished.

name: Sublevel parking
blurb: Oil stains and a running van.
description: Oil rainbows and numbered pillars carve the sublevel into kill-funnels. A van idles dark at the far end of the ramp.

name: Rooftop HVAC maze
description: Galvanized ducts and spinning fans on a gravel roof. Wind shoves hard; one loose grate opens on a long drop.

name: Clinic bay
description: Too-white lights over gurneys and red bio bags. Antiseptic fights something sweeter under a half-mopped stain.

name: Bar back room
description: Sticky floor, liquor crates, and a cage for the good bottles. Music thumps through the wall — this is where deals finish off the floor.

name: Service tunnel spur
description: Sweating pipes and copper-tasting air curve out of sight both ways. Something moved further down, or dripped.

name: Drone cage
blurb: Charging racks and a half-open gate.
description: Chain-link charging racks full of docked birds and ozone stink. One gate hangs open on a bent hinge.

name: Exec suite
blurb: Glass desk, panic button under it.
description: Glass desk, skyline view, and a panic button worn smooth under the lip. The chair is still warm.

name: Paper archive
description: Dust-thick shelves climb to a locked cage of real files. Fire — or a shredder crew — would end this room in minutes.

name: Industrial kitchen
description: Stainless steel, hanging knives, and freezers breathing frost. Something in the walk-in is not food.

name: Street chapel
description: Plastic chairs, a flickering neon cross, and candle nubs. Behind the altar cloth, a hatch cut into the floorboards.

name: Corp gym
blurb: Mirrors, free weights, blood on mat.
description: Mirrors, free weights, and a heavy bag still swaying. Blood is smeared half-wiped on the mat under watching cams.

name: Clean room airlock
description: White suits hang in an airlock with a red light that will not go green. One collar is still warm.

name: Abandoned rail platform
blurb: Rats and a dead schedule board.
description: Wet tile, rats, and a schedule board frozen on a year that never came. Trains do not stop here; other things do.

name: Mezzanine overlook
description: A rail and a drop — sightlines cut the whole hall. Cover is a potted plant and optimism.

name: Vault antechamber
description: Two heavy doors; one still sealed with a time-lock glow. Cold air and old money-smell breathe from the open side.

name: Hydroponics bay
blurb: Green light, wet deck, hidden path.
description: Green grow-light, wet grated deck, and nutrient fog. A hatch hides behind the leaves at the far wall.

name: Broadcast booth
description: Dead mics, foam walls, and one uplink light still live green. If that light is on, someone is listening.

name: Private armoury
description: Empty racks, oil-smell, and a logbook open to today with no names. The cage door is unlocked — worse than locked.

name: Vat nursery
description: Tanks bubble off-cycle under amber warning glyphs. One vat is empty and clean; the one beside it is not.

name: Net chapel
description: CRT altars and cable spaghetti in a shrine of e-waste. Screens show static that almost looks like faces.

name: Walk-in freezer
description: Knee-high fog, meat hooks, and metal that burns bare skin. Check the glowing door paddle twice before it latches.

name: Glass atrium
blurb: Too much light, too little cover.
description: Glass, plants, and a fountain — too much light, too little cover. Every footstep clicks for the cameras.

name: Mech bay
description: Oil pits and clamp arms frozen mid-reach under a hanging frame. If anything powers up, you will not outrun the clamp.

name: Burned safehouse
description: Foil-taped windows, wall maps, and spent brass in a dustpan. Three locks on the door, one kick-mark, and old smoke in the air.

name: Elevator core
description: Cables thick as wrists and a drop that eats light. A service car hangs stuck between floors with the doors cracked.

name: Shuttered market stall
description: Tarps, hanging scales, and a shutter down but not locked. A false back slides open to the next stall or the alley.

name: Dock edge
description: Water slap on pilings under one working flood. Crates wear three different corp stamps; the rest of the lights are shot out.

name: Panopticon desk
description: A horseshoe of screens loops empty halls and a lobby fountain. Most feeds are live; a shotgun is zip-tied under the desk.

name: Chrome ritual room
description: Candles on server cases and code printouts as scripture. Bad theology, real knives on the altar.

name: Crawlspace
description: Elbows, knees, wire, and insulation that itches through cloth. Sound carries — move slow or not at all.

name: Exit shaft
description: Cold ladder rungs and a circle of alley light above. The alarm panel at the bottom already blinks amber.
